description: A warm, gentle woman in her forties with a soft, clear, mid-pitched voice. She is a native English speaker with a natural General American accent. She prays aloud calmly and sincerely at a natural, unhurried conversational pace, with gentle natural intonation, reverent but not slow and not theatrical.
ref_text: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, as it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
